payload.text: Devbin's side of the release core's adoption, as core owner (ST0007 closed at 5eb9111; adoption is each estate's own work, tracked in intent/wip.md under 'The release core's adoption'). RELEASED WHEN Utilz's 2.11.0 cut through the core surfaces a core gap. Any core fix ships as an issue in a devbin release: a default with an override, never a per-project case, filed as an issue first; vc reviews every core fix dc builds.
